mechanical.title: LabWired Pathfinder — 42 mm hobby rocket with flight computer, camera and parachute

changes: Select manufacturer WeAct BlackPill DIP-40 SWD footprint
Connect prior VCC rail to manufacturer 3V3 pin
Add boost OUT+ to BlackPill 5V input
q_pyro AO3400A and q_cam AO3401A bind to AOS manufacturer records and SOT-23 G1/S2/D3
c_bulk binds Nichicon UPW1A471MPD 470uF 10V, nominal diameter8 x11.5mm, pitch3.5mm; max body diameter8.5 x13mm
Replace unspecified MT3608 breakout with Pololu U3V70F5 fixed5V module on reverse sled face; preserve every electrical rail through an explicit four-wire connector
Keep all 44 manufacturer copper pads; widen only the selected WeAct courtyard to its primary V3.1 STEP body plus0.35mm margin; original library aliases preserved
Retain the arm switch at the existing panel port and connect COM/GND and contact1/PB12 through an explicit two-wire on-board header; no duplicate switch body on PCB
Bound remaining sensor/storage/buzzer and 10/22uF capacitor selections to primary-source packages; all original wires and sensor address straps preserved.

Retained1.5ohm simulation load moved offboard as external bench load; battery source model moved offboard through sourced Phoenix1984617 terminals. Selected Tattu1SLiHV3.8Vnominal/4.35Vmax source; all electrical topology preserved through explicit interconnects.
Selected WP7113GD status LED with source-backed8.85mm maximum body plus specified1mm assembly stand-off; bulk capacitor shifted1mm inward for curved-wall clearance.

electrical_findings.battery_current_formula: I_bat = V_bat / R_load + (5 * I_5V) / (eta * V_bat) + I_aux_battery
electrical_findings.five_volt_camera_and_board_current: unmeasured; no total-current or endurance pass claimed

required_model_changes: Set the retained 1.5-ohm resistor to offboard external bench load; do not assemble an unqualified generic 0603 at 12.62W/12.62J.
Replace barrel-jack stand-in and generic load-header fabrication interfaces with sourced rated connectors or explicit direct wiring. Preserve source model pin semantics and actual topology.
Fit the battery maximum tolerance envelope and explicit connector/cable/retention volume.
Record the battery as 1S LiHV and retain maximum 4.35V separately from nominal 3.8V.
open_acceptance: Physical current, voltage sag, regulator temperature and complete camera/avionics peak budget not measured.
PCB power path current capacity and connector/cable rating need sourced implementation.
Original firmware configures VBAT ADC but does not read it; no low-voltage protection claim.
Original 1.5-ohm part is a model stand-in, not a qualified flight initiator.
Mass, center of gravity and stability must be recomputed for the new sourced pack and bay; catalogue mass is not measured assembly mass.

primary_sources.supports: SKU, capacity, nominal voltage, C-rate, nominal dimensions and published tolerance, connector; manufacturer warns C-rate is only a cell rating
9A continuous /15A burst connector rating and male/female dimensions
Existing matched BT2.0 pigtail option; wire gauge not specified in retrieved text
